scope: The 13 remaining distinct, non-composite O/early-B (B0-B5) entries with catalog Teff below 10000 K flagged after the Zeta1 Sco correction. This is a reviewed candidate set, not a blanket temperature cut or full stellar-catalog audit.
policy: Exact SIMBAD/HIP/HD and stable IDs only. Keep heterogeneous temperatures and component scope explicit. Reject dependent luminosity/radius when the original SED fit is unsuitable; do not infer a temperature from spectral type. Preserve membership, spectra, coordinates, motion and unrelated physical fields.

* bet01 Sco.label: Beta1 Sco

temperature_k.method: Extinction-corrected bolometric-flux temperature with BCD diagnostics
temperature_k.caveat: Unresolved named multiple: this is the apparent, primary-dominated temperature of the catalogued light, not a resolved measurement of every member. Blended angular diameter is not assigned to an individual component.

luminosity_solar.reason: Rejected zero-reddening broadband-fit luminosity; no independently verified component-safe replacement adopted in this temperature review.

radius_solar.reason: Radius inherited the rejected luminosity/temperature fit; no independently verified component-safe replacement adopted.
